Elara Dawn — Album 1.5: Mercy

The Morning After

"The morning after everything, the world was still turning"

[Intro — spoken softly, like scripture read at sunrise] In the beginning… there was light.

Not perfection.

Just light enough to begin again.

[Verse 1] On the first day the darkness learned its limits On the second came the sky enough to breathe On the third came roots that split the earth for growing On the fourth came distant fires to guide the sea On the fifth came songs alive inside creation On the sixth came hands that could destroy or heal On the seventh came the silence after wonder

And still… the story wasn’t sealed

[Pre-Chorus] Because every dawn arrives After destruction Every new beginning After something ends

[Chorus] The morning after everything The world was still turning The morning after everything The fires still burned but so did we Yes, there was darkness in us Yes, there were terrible things But no hidden hand created sorrow We chose What we would feed

[Verse 2] You say evil was written into every living soul Like something ancient buried underneath the skin But I’ve seen kindness survive where it should have withered I’ve seen broken people learn to love again

I’ve seen strangers carry strangers through the wreckage I’ve seen hands reach out with nothing left to gain If darkness was the only truth inside us Compassion would have died beneath the weight

[Pre-Chorus] But somewhere beyond fear Beyond survival Something softer remained And kept reaching back

[Chorus] The morning after everything The world was still breathing The morning after everything Human hearts still rose against the grief Yes, we built kingdoms from violence Yes, we worshipped fear sometimes But mercy was there too Quietly surviving The whole time

[Bridge — full choir and organ rising] No hidden day created monsters No single wound explains the soul We are every choice repeated Every hand we learn to hold

And maybe that’s more frightening

That nothing forced us Nothing cursed us Nothing wrote our fate in stone

Because if darkness is a choice

Then so is love

[Choir swell][Organ rise][Celestial harmony]

[Final Chorus — massive lift] The morning after everything The light was still waiting The morning after everything The world was wounded but alive Yes, there is darkness within us Yes, there are shadows we keep But every day we wake becomes another chance To choose What survives

The morning after everything After the wars After the grief After the fire After the endings

There was still morning

[Outro — spoken, one line at a time, soft] On the first day… light. On the second… breath. On the third… growth. On the fourth… wonder. On the fifth… song. On the sixth… us. On the seventh… rest.

And on the morning after everything…

…we began again.
